description: The whole scenario file. Step lists stay raw here; loader.steps parses them.
title: ScenarioPlay scenario

AllCondition.description: Holds when every condition holds in the same poll.
AllCondition.title: AllCondition

AnswerRule.description:
Answer a prompt automatically whenever it appears while a step waits.

`when` is a regex matched against the text before the cursor, where a program that
asks something leaves it. The answer is typed like any other input, then Enter.

when.description: Regex for the prompt, e.g. '\[sudo\] password for'.
when.title: When

secret.description: Name of a secret to type. Typed only into hidden input (the terminal is not echoing); a second prompt in the same wait fails the step, since the secret was rejected.
secret.title: Secret

text.description: Plain text to type, such as `y`.
text.title: Text

AnswerRule.title: AnswerRule

AnyCondition.description: Holds as soon as one of the conditions holds. Each may name a `console`.
AnyCondition.title: AnyCondition

AssertStep.description: Fail if the condition is false: an expression, or a screen/system condition.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

assert.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

AssertStep.title: AssertStep

BreakStep.description: Leave the innermost loop (`break: true`, usually with `when`).

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

BreakStep.title: BreakStep

CallBlock.description: Run a `define`d block with parameter values from `with`.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

CallBlock.title: CallBlock

CaptionStep.description: Show a subtitle line for some seconds without starting a chapter.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

CaptionStep.title: CaptionStep

CaptureSpec.description:
What to keep from some output: a regex (its first group, or the group named in
`group`) and/or only the last `lines` lines. Without either, the whole text.
CaptureSpec.title: CaptureSpec

CaptureStep.description:
Store output in a variable. `from`: `output` (since the last input, default),
`screen` (visible screen) or `last_output` (output of the last `run`).

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

CaptureStep.title: CaptureStep

ChapterStep.description: Start a chapter: video chapter marker, subtitle and log section.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

ChapterStep.title: ChapterStep

ClearStep.description:
Clear the console: `clear: command` (or `true`) types `clear`, `clear: key` sends
Ctrl+L.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

ClearStep.title: ClearStep

CloseConsoleStep.description: Close a console mid-take; its text still goes into the transcript.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

CloseConsoleStep.title: CloseConsoleStep

Condition.description: A wait condition (spec section 7). A bare string is a regex.

answers.description: Prompts answered automatically in this console; checked before `defaults.answers`.
answers.title: Answers

host.description: Run this console on another machine: `host` or `user@host`. The runner opens it with ssh inside the pane (key-based login).
host.title: Host

size.description: Pane size in split layouts: `30%` or a number of cells.
size.title: Size

start.description: Open at the start; false = open later with `open_console`.
start.title: Start

ContinueStep.description: Skip to the next pass of the innermost loop (`continue: true`).

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

ContinueStep.title: ContinueStep

clear_after_setup.description: Clear each console after `setup`, so the video starts clean.
clear_after_setup.title: Clear After Setup

answers.description: Prompts answered automatically in every console.
answers.title: Answers

DefineBlock.description: Declare a reusable block with parameters; `call` runs it. Defining runs nothing.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

DefineBlock.title: DefineBlock

EnterStep.description: Press Enter (`enter: true`, or `enter: 3` to press it three times).

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

EnterStep.title: EnterStep

ExecCondition.description: An out-of-view command succeeds (exit code 0). Nothing is typed on screen.
ExecCondition.title: ExecCondition

ExecStep.description:
Run a command out of view (not typed on screen), e.g. for checks. Sets
{{ last.exit_code }} and {{ last.output }}; `capture: name` stores its output.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

ExecStep.title: ExecStep

FileCondition.description: A file or directory exists on the target (checked out of view).
FileCondition.title: FileCondition

FocusStep.description:
Bring a console to the front and highlight it. `zoom: true` makes its pane fill the
screen for readability; `zoom: false` restores the layout.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

FocusStep.title: FocusStep

ForEachBlock.description: Repeat the steps for each item of a list (`for_each: [a, b]` or `"{{ var }}"`).

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

ForEachBlock.title: ForEachBlock

GoneCondition.title: GoneCondition

IdleCondition.description: The screen has not changed for this many seconds (for programs without a prompt).
IdleCondition.title: IdleCondition

IfBlock.description:
Run `then` if the condition holds; otherwise the first `elif` that holds, or
`else`. The condition is an expression or a screen/system condition checked once.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

if.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.
An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

IfBlock.title: IfBlock

IncludeStep.description:
Insert the steps of another file here (a list of steps, or a file with only
`steps:`). The path is relative to the including file. Resolved when loading.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

IncludeStep.title: IncludeStep

KeyStep.description: Send a key or combination: C-c, C-d, C-l, Tab, Up, Down, Escape, F1-F12, M-x...

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

KeyStep.title: KeyStep

LogStep.description: Write a line to the take log only.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

LogStep.title: LogStep

OnFailRetry.description: `on_fail: {retry: 3, delay: 2}`: run the failed step again, up to `retry` times.
OnFailRetry.title: OnFailRetry

OpenConsoleStep.description: Open a declared console mid-take (one with `start: false`, or one closed earlier).

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

OpenConsoleStep.title: OpenConsoleStep

ParallelBlock.description:
Run branches at the same time, one console per branch (spec 9.3).

`wait: all` (default) ends when every branch is done; `wait: any` ends when the first
branch is done and stops the others. A failing branch stops the others and fails the
block.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

ParallelBlock.title: ParallelBlock

PauseStep.description: Wait a fixed number of seconds so the viewer can read (scaled by --speed).

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

PauseStep.title: PauseStep

PortCondition.description: A TCP port accepts connections: `port: 80` (on the target) or `port: "db:5432"`.
PortCondition.title: PortCondition

PromptCondition.description:
The console's prompt is back: the prompt regex matches the last non-empty line and,
when the hidden shell hook is active, the shell has finished a command since the last
input.
PromptCondition.title: PromptCondition

RegexCondition.description: This regular expression matches the output (multi-line mode: ^ and $ match per line).
RegexCondition.title: RegexCondition

RepeatBlock.description: Repeat the steps a fixed number of times.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

RepeatBlock.title: RepeatBlock

RetryBlock.description:
Run the steps; if one fails, wait `delay` seconds and run them all again, up to
`retry` attempts in total.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

RetryBlock.title: RetryBlock

RunStep.description: Type a command, press Enter and wait for the prompt (or for `expect` / `wait_for`).

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

capture.description: Store the command's output in a variable: a name, or {name, regex, group, lines}. Needs the prompt to come back.
capture.title: Capture

RunStep.title: RunStep

ScreenshotStep.description: Save a PNG of the screen into the take's screenshots/ folder.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

ScreenshotStep.title: ScreenshotStep

SecretStep.description:
Type a secret (a password) by name. Shown on screen as the program shows it (a
password prompt shows nothing); masked as **** in every output.

The step first waits until the terminal reads input without echo, so a secret is never
typed where it would be visible. `hidden: false` drops that check.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

SecretStep.title: SecretStep

SetStep.description:
Set or change a variable: `set: name` with `value:` (templates keep their type,
so `value: "{{ packages }}"` stays a list).

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

SetStep.title: SetStep

Step.description: One step: exactly one action keyword plus its options.

StopStep.description:
End the take early: `stop: success` or `stop: failure`, with an optional message.
`finally` still runs.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

StopStep.title: StopStep

TerminalSpec.description: The full-screen terminal window that shows the tmux session.

command.description: Terminal command. A string may contain {attach}; a list gets the attach command appended. Default: the first installed of xterm, alacritty, kitty, gnome-terminal, xfce4-terminal, konsole.
command.title: Command

TerminalSpec.title: TerminalSpec

TextCondition.description: This exact text appears in the output.
TextCondition.title: TextCondition

TryBlock.description:
Run `try`; if a step fails, run `catch` (with {{ error.message }} and
{{ error.step }}) instead of failing. `finally` always runs.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

TryBlock.title: TryBlock

TypeStep.description: Type text character by character. Press Enter only with `enter: true`.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

enter_newlines.description: Press Enter for each newline in the text. Without this, text with newlines is refused.
enter_newlines.title: Enter Newlines

TypeStep.title: TypeStep

TypingSpec.description: Typing parameters; every field is optional so specs can be layered.
TypingSpec.title: TypingSpec

UntilBlock.description:
Repeat until the condition holds; it is checked after each pass, so the steps run at

until.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

UseStep.title: UseStep

WaitForStep.description: Block until a screen condition holds (spec section 7).

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

WaitForStep.title: WaitForStep

WhileBlock.description: Repeat while the condition holds; it is checked before each pass.

when.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

while.description: An expression such as `x == 1`, or a condition checked once.

WhileBlock.title: WhileBlock
